create_tsne_embedding: create a TSNE instance to reduce high-dimensional data to 2D or 3D space
build_tsne_transform: build a low-dimensional embedding from input data using TSNE fit_transform
test_tsne_trustworthiness: test how well local neighbor structure is preserved in a TSNE embedding
refactor_tsne_perplexity: refactor TSNE to compute joint probabilities with configurable perplexity
review_tsne_gradient_descent: review the gradient descent optimizer with momentum used to minimize KL divergence
